item.title: Mitchell Marsh shuts down journalist for question over Pakistan boycotting India clash in T20 WC

item.title: ISRO to relaunch PSLV in June after back-to-back failures, sabotage ruled out
item.description: ISRO will attempt a fresh PSLV launch in June after two consecutive mission failures, Union Minister Jitendra Singh said, ruling out sabotage and affirming global confidence in India’s space programme.
